entries.title: Romans 12:1
segments: I beseech you therefore, brothers, by the mercies of God to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, pleasing to God, [which is] your reasonable service.

entries.title: Romans 12:2
segments: And do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, in order to prove by you what [is] that good and pleasing and perfect will of God.

entries.title: Romans 12:3
segments: For I say, through the grace given to me, to every one who is among you, not to think [of himself] more highly than he ought to think. But set your mind to be right-minded, even as God has dealt to every man the measure of faith.

entries.title: Romans 12:4
segments: For even as we have many members in one body, and all members do not have the same function,

entries.title: Romans 12:5
segments: so we the many are one body in Christ, and each one members of one another.

entries.title: Romans 12:6
segments: Then having gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, if prophecy, according to the proportion of faith;

entries.title: Romans 12:7
segments: or ministry, in the ministry; or [he who] teaches, in the teaching;

entries.title: Romans 12:8
segments: or he who exhorts, in the encouragement; or he who shares, in simplicity; or he who takes the lead, in diligence; or he who shows mercy, in cheerfulness.

entries.title: Romans 12:9
segments: [Let] love [be] without hypocrisy, shrinking from evil, cleaving to good;

entries.title: Romans 12:10
segments: in brotherly love to one another, loving fervently, having led one another in honor.

entries.title: Romans 12:11
segments: As to diligence, not slothful, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord;

entries.title: Romans 12:12
segments: rejoicing in hope, patient in affliction, steadfastly continuing in prayer,

entries.title: Romans 12:13
segments: distributing to the needs of the saints, pursuing hospitality.

entries.title: Romans 12:14
segments: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and do not curse.

entries.title: Romans 12:15
segments: Rejoice with rejoicing ones, and weep with weeping ones;

entries.title: Romans 12:16
segments: minding the same thing toward one another, not minding high things, but yielding to the lowly. Do not be wise within yourselves.

entries.title: Romans 12:17
segments: Repay no one evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.

entries.title: Romans 12:18
segments: If [it is] possible, as far as [is] in you, seeking peace with all men.

entries.title: Romans 12:19
segments: not avenging yourselves, beloved, but giving place to wrath; for it is written, "Vengeance [is] Mine, I will repay, says [the] Lord."

entries.title: Romans 12:20
segments: Therefore if your enemy hungers, feed him. If he thirsts, give him drink. For [in so] doing you shall heap coals of fire on his head.

entries.title: Romans 12:21
segments: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
